timeline.filmstrip_rule: start: first day with at least 50 fire pixels tomorrow; largest day: most fire tomorrow; among days with at least 500 pixels tomorrow, best: highest F1, typical: median F1; shown in date order

satellite.credit: Imagery: NASA EOSDIS GIBS (VIIRS/Suomi NPP corrected reflectance, true colour).
satellite.date_rule: the day the forecast is about (next_date), one daily mosaic, not the overpass of the fire detections

cover_day.rule: chosen by eye for the card image (clear fire shapes, a visible plume, a good forecast); also the typical (median-F1) day of the story buttons; forecast mode, divider at 50%

tiles.name: Forecast wind speed
tiles.resolution: ~28 km · speed of hours 1–24 mean vector

model_view.selection_rule: timeline day nearest in calendar days to the filmstrip's median-F1 typical day; each of five input days must have at least 50% finite pixels in every NDVI, EVI2 and VIIRS reflectance channel inside the timeline crop; today's ERC, max temperature, wind speed/direction and elevation must also have at least 50% finite pixels each; ties go to the earlier date; fail if none qualifies. Finite coverage is not a cloud-quality guarantee. The threshold explainer stays on the typical day.

timeline.selection_rule: fire with the most target days having at least 50 fire pixels tomorrow; ties to the larger total fire
